استألفوا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْلَفُوا (istaʔlafū) /is.taʔ.la.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
# اِسْتَأْلِفُوا (istaʔlifū) /is.taʔ.li.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
